data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's claim asserts the log 'requires idempotent writers, not safe ones,' explicitly denying that safety is the required property. Yet its own mechanism section states 'The "safe" property (retries don't corrupt) is necessary but insufficient.' If safety is necessary, then the log DOES require safe writers—directly contradicting the claim's 'not safe ones.' The target never resolves this contradiction. Additionally, the problem demands drawing on 'published definitions,' but SRC_002's definitions, derivation, and formalization_refs arrays are all empty; it merely asserts 'the published distinction... is real' without citing or reproducing any published definition. The mechanism text is also truncated mid-sentence ('...necessary but insufficient—it'), leaving the causal argument incomplete.
